units.source_text: “不仅如此，我还发觉小姐的态度有了稍许变化。

en.t: Not only that, I also noticed a slight change in the young lady's manner.

units.source_text: 我们出门旅行了这么长时间，要恢复到以往的日常生活状态，诸般事情都需要女人照应。

en.t: After we had been away traveling for so long, getting back to our former everyday life required a woman's care in all sorts of matters.

units.source_text: 姑且不说一直照料我们的夫人，我感觉小姐凡事总是先想到我，然后是K。

en.t: Leaving aside the mistress, who had always looked after us, I felt that in everything the young lady thought of me first, and K afterward.

units.source_text: 倘若小姐做得太露骨，我也会为难的，甚至会感觉不愉快。

en.t: If the young lady had been too obvious about it, I would have felt awkward, and might even have found it unpleasant.

units.source_text: 但是在这一点上，小姐做得很有分寸，我很高兴。

en.t: But in this respect the young lady handled things with great tact, and I was pleased.

units.source_text: 就是说，小姐只让我一个人感受到她把自己的温情多分给了我一些。

en.t: In other words, she let only me sense that she was giving me a little more of her warmth.

units.source_text: K也没有显得不高兴，还是老样子。

en.t: K did not seem displeased either, and remained just as he had been before.

units.source_text: 我心里暗暗地奏起战胜了他的凯歌。

en.t: In my heart, I secretly sounded a song of triumph over him.

units.source_text: 从九月中旬开始，我们又要到学校去上课了。

en.t: From the middle of September, we had to go back to school for classes.

units.source_text: 由于各人的课程不同，我和K回家的时间又有早有晚了。

en.t: Because our courses were different, K and I once again came home at different times, sometimes earlier and sometimes later.

units.source_text: 一个星期我有三天比K晚回来。

en.t: Three days a week, I came home later than K.

units.source_text: 不过，无论我什么时候回来，都没有在K的房间里见到过小姐了。

en.t: However, no matter when I came home, I no longer saw the young lady in K's room.

units.source_text: K还是跟以前一样抬起眼睛，对我机械地重复一声：‘刚回来？’

en.t: K would still raise his eyes as before and mechanically repeat to me, 'Just got back?'

units.source_text: 我也如同机械一般，简单而无意义地点点头。

en.t: I too would nod simply and meaninglessly, almost like a machine.
